short: The civilization of the ancient Greeks, spanning from the Mycenaean period to the Roman conquest.
full: Ancient Greece was a foundational civilization in the Mediterranean that pioneered democratic government, Western philosophy, dramatic arts, and scientific inquiry. Despite being divided into independent city-states often at war with one another, the Greeks shared a common language, religion, and culture, most visibly during the Panhellenic Games. Their influence was spread across the known world by the conquests of Alexander the Great.
